name: curry
notes: CURRY scene rebuild (plan fizzy-dreaming-clover, Tony's 16 refs; research/sprint-0930/curry/SHOTLIST.md). Runs after r3-rain and before love (love + gacha stay last), so the v2-curry beat numbers below are the ORIGINAL ones: r3-rain's beat-5 curry-street lands on the exit, and love's beat-1 loveHidden still hits the pick (every insert here is at 2 or later).

The choice moves OUT to the street (2:55 PM, two shop fronts): butter chicken stays in v2-curry (NAND HOUSE, the Indian shop), katsu goes to v2-curry-katsu (OR OR CURRY), not hungry goes to v2-curry-alone (the katsu shop, she eats alone).

v2-curry after this pack: 0 street stamp 2:55 | 1 the pick | 2 door + bell | 3 interior stamp 3:00 | 4 two-shot, knee | 5 HERO thali | 6 naan tear | 7 sauce | 8 naan dip | 9 'Feed me' (your hand) | 10 her eyes | 11 lassi | 12 exit 3:40 (curry-street).
Voice takes are scene + words: every recorded v2-curry line keeps its words and stays in v2-curry. The katsu path's 'Feed me' line is in its own scene, so it has no take.

beats.text: Insert. She pushes the yellow door. A bell rings.
Two seats at the counter. She sits at your right. Her knee touches yours.
Close-up. Katsu curry. She cuts one small piece. Crunch.
Extreme close-up. Brown curry. Soft potato. Hot rice.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Feed me. With your hand. Not the spoon. Your hand.
She eats from your fingers. Her eyes never leave your face.
She wipes your fingers with her napkin. Then she keeps the napkin for her collection.
Insert. She pushes the yellow door. A bell rings.
She eats alone. You get nothing. She stares at you the whole time.
She folds her napkin and keeps it. For her collection.

set.text: CURRY STREET · 2:55 PM. Two curry shops, side by side.
Close-up. She tears the naan with two fingers.

beats.text: Her mango lassi. She pushes it to you. One straw.
More butter sauce. Thick, orange, and shiny.
Extreme close-up. She dips the naan. The sauce drips.
Insert. She pushes the glass door. A bell rings.
Inside NAND HOUSE. A dance video plays on the TV.
Two seats by the window. She sits at your right. Her knee touches yours.
The lunch set. Butter chicken, saag, rice, and one giant naan.
